messages.msg: Q14 explains call order on StoryCard with two calls, likes first and isBookmarked second, and logs both values on each render. Q37 can break that same order (a useState inside if (likes > 0)) so the reader sees the rule fail on code they already know. React 19.3 then logs 'React has detected a change in the order of Hooks called by StoryCard' and throws 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render.' Recall the model from Q14 state-lives-in-react rather than teaching it again.
